ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 30:70 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white zones are concentrated on the distal margins and upper trailing edges of both lobes. The left lobe features a larger, more continuous white patch extending from the tip toward the center. The basal region and central area surrounding the notch are dominated by contiguous low-intensity dark pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 18 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 45 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; edge exhibits deep, irregular jaggedness, particularly on the inner section of the left lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer leading edges, sweeping upward to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of circular, high-contrast white pixel aggregates located on the far-left outer leading edge and tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light on dark) visible in the upper-medial region of the left lobe's dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular scarring and potential tissue loss along the far-left margin, characterized by a jagged profile and high-contrast white textural clusters.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, disproportionately deep V-shaped indentation located on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, distinct from the standard serration pattern.
